title: Salmai the Netophathite
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: His sons are praised in [Taanit 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.28a.10-12): once the government forbade bringing wood for the altar fire, but they cleverly brought it nevertheless. Of them the sages said, “The memory of the righteous is for a blessing.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked story names the sons of Salmai the Netophathite and explains how they carried the wood past the guards as ladders. It applies the blessing over the memory of the righteous to them and others like them.
